note: demo-digital-arrest in English, for viewers who don't speak Hindi. A written demo script, not a real call: names, numbers and IDs are made up, and the voices are synthetic.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is Inspector Sharma from the Mumbai Crime Branch. Am I speaking to Sunita Verma?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Madam, a FedEx parcel was sent on your Aadhaar card, and we found drugs and five fake passports in it. An FIR has been filed in your name.

turns.speaker: listener
turns.text: What? I never sent any parcel.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is a very serious money laundering case. You have to do the verification right now, or an arrest warrant will be issued.

turns.speaker: listener
turns.text: Let me talk to my son first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No madam, this case is confidential. Don't tell anyone, not even your family. And don't disconnect this call.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm moving you to a Skype video call. Keep your camera on.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: For verification, you have to transfer all the money in your account to RBI's safe account. Send two lakh rupees now, you'll get it back after verification.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Write down the account number: 501234567890, IFSC HDFC0001234. Or send it by UPI to rbi.verify@okaxis.
